name: Triangle-Box Intersection Voxelization
aliases: Mesh Voxelization via SDF and Occupancy
definition: A parallel C++ implementation that voxelizes watertight triangular meshes into Signed Distance Functions (SDFs) or occupancy grids. SDFs store the distance from a voxel reference point (corner or center) to the nearest mesh face, with negative signs for interior voxels. Occupancy grids identify voxels intersecting the mesh surface.
